data.desc: TAL Education Group is a smart learning solutions provider in China. The acronym 'TAL' stands for 'Tomorrow Advancing Life', which reflects our vision to promote top learning opportunities for students through both high-quality teaching and content, as well as leading edge application of technology in the education experience. TAL Education Group offers comprehensive learning solutions to students from all ages through diversified class formats. Our learning solutions mainly cover enrichment learnings programs and some academic subjects in and out of China. Our ADSs trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol 'TAL'.
